July's AirPods Pro 3 $50 discount, AirPods Max 2 $100 price drop, and ongoing AirTag 2 historical low deals remain in effect. However, today's top story from 9to5Toys' midday brief is Apple's official refurbished store—currently offering up to $240 off the most affordable M5 MacBook Air model, see here for details. These deals run alongside up to $500 off M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pro models, a new historical low on the David Pogue《Apple: The First 50 Years》hardcover book, and a $50 launch discount on Sharge's new transparent metal 24000mAh RGB smart display power bank. All deals are listed below.

July summer deals: AirPods stock starting to dwindle—AirPods Pro 3, Max 2 and more still up to $100 off

  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (original price $249)
  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (original price $549)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (original price $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $145 (original price $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (original new price $179) — Renewed Premium refurbished

July is coming to an end, and AirPods deals this month will likely conclude with it. Some July promotions run through Sunday, so deals like AirPods Pro 3 discounts and AirPods Max 2 $100 price drops may extend into the weekend, but that's uncertain at this point, while the AirPods 4 Active Noise Cancellation deal was pulled from Amazon earlier this morning.

The 'July Black Friday' brings another round of significant discounts across the current AirPods lineup, with the AirPods Pro 3 $50 price drop being the most noteworthy. Meanwhile, the 2026 AirPods Max 2 sees a substantial $100 price cut, and the AirPods 4 with Active Noise Cancellation hit their best price in months. The latter is now sold out, and other models may follow suit soon.

Apple's official refurbished store offers best deal yet on M5 MacBook Air—up to $240 off

Apple's official certified refurbished store currently offers the lowest prices anywhere on the M5 MacBook Air. Although the entry-level 13-inch M5 model has seen a price increase, you can still purchase it directly from Apple for $1,099 with shipping, complete with a full one-year warranty—this price is even better than what major retailers offer for new sealed units—other configurations are also available with up to $240 off Apple's pricing.

M5 MacBook Air lowest prices

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (original new price $1,599) — $240 off

Apple's official certified refurbished store is currently selling the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air for $200 below new pricing. This is the entry-level model, and the most affordable configuration available here, featuring 16GB RAM and 512GB storage, priced at $1,099 with shipping.

Apple official refurbished program details:

  • Quality products at affordable prices
  • Undergo rigorous refurbishment process before sale
  • One-year Apple limited warranty included
  • 14-day Apple return policy
  • AppleCare service plans available for purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services not available for refurbished products
  • Limited availability

There was a time when you could get this machine for even less, but those days are long gone; since the price increase, finding an M5 MacBook Pro for under $1,199 has become extremely difficult.

If you're looking to get an M5 MacBook Air at the lowest price from the (admittedly) most reliable and trustworthy source online, these deals from Apple's official certified refurbished store are absolutely worth considering.

We may see Amazon slash prices on new units of this model in the future, but for now, with retail prices having just been raised, seeing discounts of $200 or more in the short term doesn't seem promising.

For comparison, here are Amazon's current new unit prices:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB starting at $1,199 (current original price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB starting at $1,499 (current original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB starting at $1,699 (current original price $1,799)

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB starting at $1,899 (current original price $1,999)

AirTag 2 'July Black Friday' historical low deal still in effect ($22 each)

Sharge's new transparent metal 24000mAh RGB smart display power bank $50 off (launch deal)

Not all power banks are created equal—some feature built-in displays and integrated USB-C cables, while others sport an extremely Cyberpunk-inspired internal and external design that exposes the electronic components. Sharge's new Shargeek 24000mAh power bank combines all of the above, featuring RGB lighting effects, a smart display, and a window that reveals the internal structure. The product is also launching with a notable $50 discount.

Sharge's Amazon official store is currently selling the brand-new Shargeek 300W power bank for $179 with shipping, featuring 24000mAh battery capacity—remember to use the coupon on the page.

This buzzworthy power bank, originally priced at $229, is now $50 off, marking the lowest price we've tracked since its launch one to two weeks ago.

If you're into this kind of product, this is absolutely a stunning-looking portable charger. But before discussing the aesthetics, let's look at the specs:

  • 300W total output: 140W + 140W + 20W, capable of charging three devices simultaneously.
  • Dual USB-C PD 3.1 140W fast charging, available from either port.
  • 24,000mAh capacity: provides all-day power for laptops and various devices.
  • 5–28V DC power supply: designed for cameras and creator devices.
  • Flight-approved: 88.8Wh; airline regulations may vary.

UGREEN launches 160W smart display charger with retractable cable—all-new Nexode Pro $50 off (launch deal)

Apple 20-core 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro $300 off on Amazon, 16-core model $500 off

While we're still tracking the significant $500 discount on the 24GB/2TB 15-core M5 Pro MacBook Pro, those seeking more power can now get the best $300 discount on the 18-core model—the best deal since the price increase took effect.

Amazon is currently selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro for $2,899 with shipping, featuring 24GB RAM and 2TB storage. Originally priced at $3,199, this model comes with an 18-core CPU and 20-core GPU, $300 below retail.

This is indeed the lowest price we've tracked on Amazon since the price increase, with savings of $300. But if you don't need the 18-core CPU plus 20-core GPU configuration, you can get the same model with a 15-core CPU and 16-core GPU for a $500 discount:

  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 15-core/16-core $2,499 (original price $2,999) — $500 off
  • 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB/2TB 18-core/20-core $2,899 (original price $3,199) — $300 off

It's unclear how long this $500 discount will last, but if you're considering upgrading to a MacBook Pro, this is definitely worth keeping an eye on.

Apple official iPhone Air MagSafe battery drops to $59—Amazon historical low (40% off)

Attention iPhone Air users, this morning we're featuring a 40% discount on Apple's official iPhone Air MagSafe battery.

Amazon is currently selling the Apple iPhone Air MagSafe battery for $59 with shipping.

Originally priced at $99, now offered at a 40% discount, priced lower than Apple and other authorized resellers.

Since this product launched alongside the ultra-thin iPhone Air in September, we've seen deals around 20% off to about $79 in mid-January. From May onwards, Amazon has occasionally offered deeper discounts. We've seen Amazon low prices matching today's deal multiple times now.

Although this official MagSafe battery works with other MagSafe devices, it's specifically designed to fit perfectly against the back of the iPhone Air. While there are certainly cheaper alternatives on the market, Apple's offering is one of the thinnest available, capable of providing up to 65% charge for your iPhone Air to last 'all day,' and supports streamlined iOS widgets functionality.

Discounted official Apple USB-C, Thunderbolt, and MagSafe cables see an additional 10% off, deals starting from $7.50 each

Amazon's best quality refurbished iPhone 17 Pro $220 off, 17 Pro Max up to $450 off

If you're looking to get the current iPhone 17 Pro or Pro Max at a discount, there are still some options this week. While deals on new unlocked units from reputable sellers are harder to come by, we are still tracking Amazon's best quality refurbished 17 Pros with up to $220 off, while Woot is once again offering up to $450 off the 17 Pro Max.

Amazon is once again offering up to $220 off on 1TB and 512GB iPhone 17 Pro models—these are Amazon Renewed Premium refurbished units, backed by a one-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and 'over 90% original battery life.' Standard Amazon refurbished units only come with a 90-day warranty and don't include the same battery guarantee.
